ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (~90% dark gray/black) with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at the peripheral margins and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark-intensity field across the fluke body. Discrete high-intensity circular and sub-circular blobs (3-20 pixels in diameter) are concentrated at the distal tips and along the leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation, calculated at approximately 55 degrees at the vertex; depth correlates to roughly 10% of the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-serrations across both lobes. Left lobe shows a relatively continuous jagged edge; right lobe features a significant macro-indentation (u-shaped loss) approximately halfway between the notch and the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double convex upward sweep from the central notch towards the lateral tips, with the right lobe showing higher irregularity due to edge loss.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixels (barnacles) localized at the lateral tips and along the anterior margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned light-gray linear streaks visible on the central-left ventral surface, contrasting with the dark background pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular traumatic notch/lesion on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive peripheral calcified/parasitic scarring (barnacles) on distal regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive asymmetric profile due to the deep indentation on the right lobe trailing edge compared to the more intact left lobe.
